title: The First Sovereign's Voice
summary: As Chronos-Malek yields, the spiritual consciousness of First Sovereign Asmodaius manifests from the Crown, guiding Ha-Jun through the sacred temporal reversion ritual.

panels.shot: golden chronal sparks showering down across the amphitheater floor
panels.action: Billions of glittering golden gear fragments rain down gently onto the circular marble amphitheater floor like warm summer snow.
panels.prose_en: Billions of glittering golden gear fragments rain down gently onto the circular marble amphitheater floor like warm summer snow.
panels.prose_hi: Arabon chamchamate sunhare gear ke tukde garm garmi ki barf ki tarah golakar sangmarmar ke emphitheater farsh par dhire-dhire barsate han.

panels.shot: chronos-malek body reforming into a peaceful golden monk silhouette
panels.action: The shattered mechanical abomination condenses into a serene, six-foot monk draped in white and gold silk robes.

dialogue.speaker: chronos
dialogue.text: You possess the steel of a king and the heart of a loving brother. The Hourglass is yours.

panels.prose_en: The shattered mechanical abomination condenses into a serene, six-foot monk draped in white and gold silk robes.
panels.prose_hi: Bikhri hui yantrik ghrina safed aur sunhare reshmi vastron mein lipte ek shant, chhah foot ke sadhu mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: the hourglass of eternal abyss floating down into ha-jun open hands
panels.action: The two-meter hourglass shrinks gracefully to the size of an antique lantern, descending into Ha-Jun's outstretched palms.
panels.prose_en: The two-meter hourglass shrinks gracefully to the size of an antique lantern, descending into Ha-Jun's outstretched palms.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki faili hui hatheliyon mein utarte hue, do meter ka ghantaghar ek prachin lalten ke aakaar mein khubsurti se sikud jata hai.

panels.shot: the crown of the sovereign on ha-jun head blazing with celestial light
panels.action: The Crown of the Sovereign atop Ha-Jun's brow erupts in pure white and violet celestial radiance.
panels.prose_en: The Crown of the Sovereign atop Ha-Jun's brow erupts in pure white and violet celestial radiance.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki bhaunh ke upar samprabhu ka mukut shuddh safed aur baingani akashiya chamak mein chamakta hai.

panels.shot: an ethereal phantom of asmodaius appearing behind ha-jun
panels.action: Hovering protectively behind Ha-Jun appears the translucent, regal phantom of First Sovereign Asmodaius in full royal mantle.

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: Well fought, Ha-Jun Kang. The final key has answered your blood.

panels.prose_en: Hovering protectively behind Ha-Jun appears the translucent, regal phantom of First Sovereign Asmodaius in full royal mantle.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke peeche surakshatmak roop se mandrate hue purna shahi aavaran mein pratham samprabhu esmodius ka parbhasi, shahi pret dikhai deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking over his shoulder acknowledging the ancient king
panels.action: Ha-Jun nods with mutual respect: 'Lord Asmodaius. Show me how to save Tae-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tell me how to use the sand without destroying his soul.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun nods with mutual respect: 'Lord Asmodaius. Show me how to save Tae-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun paraspar samman ke saath sir hilate han: 'lord esmodius. mujhe dikhao ki taaye-jun ko kaise bachaya jaye.'

panels.shot: asmodaius pointing a translucent finger toward the hourglass glass
panels.action: Asmodaius: 'Invert the vessel. Draw seven grains of sand for the seven years of imprisonment.'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: Seven grains of golden sand. Let each grain dissolve into his bloodstream.

panels.prose_en: Asmodaius: 'Invert the vessel. Draw seven grains of sand for the seven years of imprisonment.'.
panels.prose_hi: Esmodius: 'bartan ko ulta karo. karawas ke saat varshon ke liye ret ke saat daane nikalo.'

panels.shot: ha-jun gently laying tae-jun down onto the golden sand floor
panels.action: Ha-Jun kneels, gently resting Tae-Jun's head upon his folded black coat like a pillow on the soft sand.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun kneels, gently resting Tae-Jun's head upon his folded black coat like a pillow on the soft sand.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ghutnon ke bal baith jata hai, naram ret par takiye ki tarah apne mude hue kale coat par taaye-jun ka sir dheere se tika deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun opening the top valve of the hourglass with glowing thumb
panels.action: Ha-Jun touches the brass latch; the top chamber unlocks with a melodious crystalline chime.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun touches the brass latch; the top chamber unlocks with a melodious crystalline chime.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun pital ki kundi ko chhuta hai; sheersh kaksh ek madhur crystaliy jhankar ke saath khulta hai.

panels.shot: seven microscopic grains of golden starlight sand floating onto ha-jun fingertip
panels.action: Seven tiny grains of golden sand, each containing miniature swirling galaxies, rest upon Ha-Jun's index finger.
panels.prose_en: Seven tiny grains of golden sand, each containing miniature swirling galaxies, rest upon Ha-Jun's index finger.
panels.prose_hi: Sunhari ret ke saat chhote dane, jinmein se pratyek mein laghu ghumti hui aakashagangaen han, ha-jun ki tarjani par tiki hui han.

panels.shot: ha-jun pressing the seven grains against tae-jun forehead
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses his glowing finger gently against Tae-Jun's forehead, right between his dormant demonic horns.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hyung... Wapas aa jao. Tumhara safar poora hua.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun presses his glowing finger gently against Tae-Jun's forehead, right between his dormant demonic horns.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni chamakti ungli ko taaye-jun ke mathe par dheere se dabata hai, theek uske nishkriya rakshasi seengon ke bich.

panels.shot: golden ripples of chronal energy spreading across tae-jun skin
panels.action: Golden rings of light ripple across Tae-Jun's face, neck, and chest, washing away seven years of trauma.
panels.prose_en: Golden rings of light ripple across Tae-Jun's face, neck, and chest, washing away seven years of trauma.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ke chehre, gardan aur chhati par prakash ke sunhare chhalle tarangit ho rahe han, jo saat saal ke aaghat ko dho rahe han.

panels.shot: the black necrotic void veins reversing their path and dissolving
panels.action: The black poison lines retreat rapidly back along Tae-Jun's throat, vanishing into clean, healthy peach skin.
panels.prose_en: The black poison lines retreat rapidly back along Tae-Jun's throat, vanishing into clean, healthy peach skin.
panels.prose_hi: Kali zahar rekhaen taaye-jun ke gale ke saath teji se peeche hatati han, aur saf, swasth aduu ki tvacha mein gayab ho jaati han.

panels.shot: tae-jun scars and needle marks fading into smooth porcelain flesh
panels.action: Seven years of laboratory biopsy scars, needle tracks, and burns seal and disappear completely.
panels.prose_en: Seven years of laboratory biopsy scars, needle tracks, and burns seal and disappear completely.
panels.prose_hi: Saat saal ki prayogshala biopsy ke nishan, sui ke nishan, aur jale hue nishan seal ho gaye aur puri tarah se gayab ho gaye.

panels.shot: the small demonic horns on tae-jun temples retracting smoothly
panels.action: The forced demonic horns retract smoothly into his skull, leaving behind noble golden guardian marks on his brow.
panels.prose_en: The forced demonic horns retract smoothly into his skull, leaving behind noble golden guardian marks on his brow.
panels.prose_hi: Majboor rakshasi seeng aasani se uski khopdi mein ghus jaate han, aur uske mathe par mahan sunhare sanrakshak ke nishan chhod jaate han.

panels.shot: tae-jun taking a sudden deep, gasping breath of pure fresh air
panels.action: Tae-Jun's chest surges; he inhales a massive, life-giving gasp of air as his dormant heart beats with full thunder.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's chest surges; he inhales a massive, life-giving gasp of air as his dormant heart beats with full thunder.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ki chhati mein uchhal; jab uska supt hriday puri gadgdahat ke saath dhadkata hai to wah hawa ki ek vishal, jeevandaayi saans leta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun royal violet eyes fluttering open looking directly at ha-jun
panels.action: Tae-Jun's eyes open wide—clear, vibrant, filled with brilliant royal violet light and complete sanity.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's eyes open wide—clear, vibrant, filled with brilliant royal violet light and complete sanity.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ki aankhen khuli hui hain - spasht, jivant, shandar shahi baingani roshni aur purna vivek se bhari hui.

panels.shot: ha-jun gripping tae-jun hands laughing through streaming tears
panels.action: Ha-Jun grabs his brother's warm hands, laughing through hot tears of pure relief and joy.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hyung!! You're awake!! You're really awake!!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun grabs his brother's warm hands, laughing through hot tears of pure relief and joy.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne bhai ke garm hathon ko pakadta hai, shuddh rahat aur khushi ke garm aansuon ke saath hansta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun sitting up pulling ha-jun into a fierce, brotherly embrace
panels.action: Tae-Jun sits up and pulls Ha-Jun into a crushing, powerful hug, burying his face into Ha-Jun's hair.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: You actually did it, you crazy kid... You came all the way to Tartarus for me.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun sits up and pulls Ha-Jun into a crushing, powerful hug, burying his face into Ha-Jun's hair.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun baithta hai aur ha-jun ko ek kuchalne wale, shaktishali aalingan mein khinchta hai, aur apna chehra ha-jun ke baalon mein chhipa deta hai.

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto tae-jun shoulder rubbing his beak against his neck
panels.action: Kuro nuzzles Tae-Jun's ear affectionately: 'Welcome back, Subject Zero. You gave us quite a headache.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Bohot so liye. Ab utho aur fight karo.

panels.prose_en: Kuro nuzzles Tae-Jun's ear affectionately: 'Welcome back, Subject Zero. You gave us quite a headache.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne pyar se taaye-jun ke kaan ko thapthpaya: 'vaaps swagat hai, subject jeero. aapne hamen kafi sirdard de diya.'

panels.shot: sudden sharp pang of temporal feedback striking ha-jun cortex
panels.action: Ha-Jun suddenly winces, clutching his temples as a sharp flash of blue temporal lightning zaps his brain.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ugh... Dimaag mein ek ajeeb sa blank space ban gaya...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun suddenly winces, clutching his temples as a sharp flash of blue temporal lightning zaps his brain.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun achanak apni kanpatiyon ko pakadte hue karah uthta hai, jaise neeli laukik bijli ki tej chamak uske mastishk ko jhakjhor deti hai.

panels.shot: a memory fragment dissolving into grey mist: 6th grade graduation
panels.action: A hazy image of an elementary school playground and a graduation certificate fades into empty white fog.
panels.prose_en: A hazy image of an elementary school playground and a graduation certificate fades into empty white fog.
panels.prose_hi: Prathmik vidyalaya ke khel ke maidan aur snatak pramanpatra ki dhundhli chhavi khali safed kohre mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun blinking realizing he can't remember his 6th grade teacher's face
panels.action: Ha-Jun blinks: 'Wait... Who was my middle school homeroom teacher? I... can't remember.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chehra gayab ho gaya... But it doesn't matter. Tae-Jun is here.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun blinks: 'Wait... Who was my middle school homeroom teacher? I... can't remember.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun palkein jhapkate han: 'ruko... mere middle school homrum shikshak kaun the? mujhe... yaad nahin aa raha.'

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling gently letting the forgotten memory go without regret
panels.action: Ha-Jun lets out a soft breath and smiles; the trade was worth it a million times over.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lets out a soft breath and smiles; the trade was worth it a million times over.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ek dhimi saans chhodta hai aur muskurata hai; vyapar ka mulya isse lakhon guna adhik tha.

panels.shot: min-jae and baek unfreezing as the temporal field stabilizes
panels.action: Min-Jae and Captain Baek stumble forward as their muscles unfreeze: 'Whoa! What just happened?!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Did the whole room just flash gold?!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae and Captain Baek stumble forward as their muscles unfreeze: 'Whoa! What just happened?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je aur captain bak ladkhadate hue aage badhte hain kyonki unki manspeshiyan dhili ho jaati han: 'vah! abhi kya hua?!'

panels.shot: min-jae gasping seeing tae-jun standing tall and healthy
panels.action: Min-Jae points with trembling fingers: 'Tae-Jun hyung?! He's standing?! He looks completely cured!'
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae points with trembling fingers: 'Tae-Jun hyung?! He's standing?! He looks completely cured!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je kampati ungaliyon se ishara karte han: 'taaye-jun hung?! wah khada hai?! wah puri tarah theek lag raha hai!'

panels.shot: captain baek saluting tae-jun with deep military respect
panels.action: Captain Baek renders a solemn salute: 'Kang Tae-Jun. It is an honor to finally meet the hero of Section 9.'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Your sacrifice saved thousands of children, son.

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek renders a solemn salute: 'Kang Tae-Jun. It is an honor to finally meet the hero of Section 9.'.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake ek gambhir salami dete han: 'cong taaye-jun. akhirkar section 9 ke nayak se milna samman ki baat hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun returning the salute with dignified strength
panels.action: Tae-Jun smiles warmly: 'Thank you, Captain. But my little brother is the real hero here.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Captain Baek. Aur Ha-Jun... Tum par garv hai mujhe.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun smiles warmly: 'Thank you, Captain. But my little brother is the real hero here.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun garmjoshi se muskurate han: 'dhanyavad, capton. lekin mera chhota bhai yahan asli hero hai.'

panels.shot: asmodaius spirit fading with a satisfied, regal smile
panels.action: First Sovereign Asmodaius dissolves into golden stardust: 'Now prepare. The Void Primordial has sensed the Tenth Relic.'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: The final battle is at hand. Stand as one.

panels.prose_en: First Sovereign Asmodaius dissolves into golden stardust: 'Now prepare. The Void Primordial has sensed the Tenth Relic.'.
panels.prose_hi: Pahle sovereign esmodius sunhare stardust mein ghul jata hai: 'ab taiyar ho jao. shunya aadim ne dasven avashesh ko mahsoos kiya hai.'

panels.shot: the entire tartarus fortress groaning under a titanic dimensional tremor
panels.action: A catastrophic seismic shockwave rocks Tartarus; three blood-red suns eclipse the black sky as Arc 8 reaches its zenith!

dialogue.text: THE THREE PRIMORDIAL SOVEREIGNS HAVE AWAKENED.

panels.prose_en: A catastrophic seismic shockwave rocks Tartarus; three blood-red suns eclipse the black sky as Arc 8 reaches its zenith!.
panels.prose_hi: Ek vinashkari bhukampiy shockwev ne tarters ko hilakar rakh diya; jaise hi arc 8 apne charam par pahunchta hai, teen rakt-lal surya kale aakash ko grahan karte han!
